task: Classify immune class in colon adenocarcinoma. Classes: low, medium, and high immune class. Key H&E indicators are the density and distribution of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, stromal inflammatory infiltrates, lymphoid aggregates, and the degree of immune-rich tumor microenvironment.

classes.0: Low immune class with sparse tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes and minimal stromal inflammatory infiltrate.
classes.1: Medium immune class with a moderate inflammatory infiltrate and intermediate numbers of tumor-associated lymphocytes.
classes.2: High immune class with dense tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, prominent stromal inflammation, and frequent lymphoid aggregates.
